summoner.prompt: Production game sprite animation sheet, exactly 4 columns x 5 rows, 20 equal square cells, transparent background. One character per cell, no labels/text/borders/shadows/background. Camera elevated three-quarter view facing RIGHT, matching supplied Duskguard enemy reference. Angular gothic grotesque with coarse pixel edges, thick black outlines, large flat shapes, bone ivory, dusty mauve, burgundy and charcoal, tiny vermilion accents. No green/blue magic, no bloom, no blur or gradients. Constant character design, anatomy, weapon hands, equipment sizes across all twenty frames. Leave 10% empty margin within each cell, identical ground baseline, do not enlarge crouching or fallen poses. Animation poses chronological left to right per row. Distinct clear motion, restrained body bob, joints bend consistently. NEW ENEMY: dead necromancer summoner, gaunt hunched skeletal corpse, exposed ivory jaw inside tall ragged dusty-lilac hood, jagged bone shoulder mantle, tattered burgundy stole and charcoal long robe, skeletal feet. Tall crooked bone staff held always in FAR right-side hand, small hanging funeral bell beneath hooked staff tip; near empty skeletal hand casts spells. Sinister distinctive silhouette, thin and elongated, NOT armored melee knight. Row1 four subtle idle frames: robe/bell sway, head breathing-like motion. Row2 four walking phases: alternating bony feet, supported contact and passing poses, staff carried consistently. Row3 four summon phases: crouched anticipation, free hand rising, full commanding hand extended with small angular burgundy-bone fragments near palm, recover; no summoned creature in these cells. Row4 four hit/recovery poses: recoil backward, strongest recoil, steadying with staff, return. Row5 four death stages: buckle, fall to knees, collapse sideways, final small heap of robe skull and staff on same ground line. Match reference painted pixel texture exactly, full figure and staff in every cell.

undead-warrior.prompt: Use case stylized-concept. Production Duskguard sprite sheet for a NEW SUMMONED UNDEAD WARRIOR. Exactly 4 columns by 5 rows, 20 equal square cells, transparent background, no text/grid/border.
